sloka: स्नेहो मे परमो राजंस्त्वयि तिष्ठतु नित्यदा ।भक्तिश्च नियता वीर भावो नान्यत्र गच्छतु ।। ७.४०.१५ ॥
transliteration: sneho me paramo rājaṁstvayi tiṣṭhatu nityadā ।bhaktiśca niyatā vīra bhāvo nānyatra gacchatu ।। 7.40.15 ॥

translations.english: O King, may my supreme affection for you remain always, and O hero, may my devotion be unwavering, with my feelings never straying elsewhere.
